turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard first?
An answer to what? I asked you who decided, and you haven't told me.
Either Owen admits it in writing by Friday at 3 PM or the zero goes on his transcript.
Admits what, Hale? You've shown me nothing, and now you're threatening his transcript. Under which section of your procedure?
Those are the only two options. Pick one.
No. I don't pick between a confession and a threat. Show me what you have, or I'm going down the hall to the principal.
